title: Card enrollment
description: Which Attractap readers may enroll and reset RFID cards. A new card key is written through the reader, so allow only readers in a place you trust.

mode.label: Enroll and reset RFID cards on
mode.description: Readers that are not allowed here still let members sign in with their cards.

all.label: All readers
all.description: Every reader with firmware 2.0.0 or later can enroll and reset RFID cards.

selected.label: Selected readers
selected.description: Only the readers you pick below can enroll and reset RFID cards.

readers.label: Allowed readers
readers.description: Pick the readers that may enroll and reset RFID cards.
readers.required: Select at least one reader, or choose all readers.

blockers.firmwareUpdateRequired: Cannot write cards until it runs firmware 2.0.0 or later.
blockers.noCardEnrollment: This reader model cannot enroll or reset cards.
